enemies.notes: Inflicts Instant Death & uses SP Lowering

bosses.name: Albert, Amon
bosses.strategy:
Albert's Holy Chest attack will do some decent damage, but even worse,
it'll reduce the amount of SP your entire party has by half, so making
sure that you had those Will Power Accessories equipped will help MAJORLY
in keeping the SP damage from happening. Other than that, he has a
physical attack that will do a decent amount of damage, and his
Revelation attack will also do a decent amount of damage, but to your
entire party with a chance of Instant Death. He rarely uses Revelation,
but if you have problems with the Instant Death it causes, equip some
Leonardo's Bears and try again.

Have Yuri fuse into Ifrit (or Forron if he has it) and cast Ignition (or
Battle Cry) to boost his attack (as well as Margarete's, if you're using
Ifrit and have the time), then have him attack normally every round.
Alice should cast Holy Edge on both Yuri and Margarete to start with,
then have her be devoted each round to casting Arc to keep everyone
healed. Margarete should have the Mind's Eye equipped and attacking
normally while being laced with Holy Edge, just like Yuri.

Any time after dealing over 2000 damage to Albert, he will fuse into
Amon. Continue with the exact same strategy as above, minus the Holy Edge
since Amon is non-class.

Amon's Atomic Dust spell will do pretty good damage to your entire party,
and he'll also hit with his physical attacks, which can cause major
damage to a single ally. You need to watch out for Demon Rays though, as
it'll either kill or nearly kill whomever it hits.

notes.text: Make sure to have 3 Will Powers and 3 Leonardo's Bears (optional) for the next boss battle, as he can use both SP Lowering and Instant Death.

With the newer weapons, the hit area is decreased once again. We'll be finding another Mind's Eye inside (which I think works great with Margarete, since she has one of the easiest rings), so you may want to invest the Cash with Meiyuan to increase both Yuri's and Margarete's Hit Areas to help, ONCE you find their new weapons in the next area. Don't worry, they're not too far in.

If you want to just grab Yuri's and Margarete's weapons really quick to upgrade them, Yuri's is one screen to the right and up (slightly hidden), and Margarete's is two screens to the left (slightly hidden).

Keep in mind that in addition to Meiyuan, Chris in the London Rats' hideout can now switch your party members for you.

After the dialogue, enter the pretty slick-looking house on the left. Make your
way down the stairs, and just before reaching the center, take the stairs off
to your left and past the vending machine here to the end, where you'll find
the final gravestone, the [_LIGHT GRAVESTONE_].

There's nothing else to do in here, so leave the house, then make your way
north up the hill. Examine the tombstone to your northwest to find the grave of
James O'Flaherty, then open the chest just to the right of it for a
[_MANT.OFNOBILITY_] for Keith. Go through the doorway here to be within the
walls of the Monastery for an event.

When you regain control, go east, following the path at the top of the screen
as it goes east, then down to a dead-end where you'll find a
[_TALISMANOFPOWER_]. Once you have it, head back to Roger's house, where you'll
have to watch an extremely long series of events.

When you regain control once again, examine the vending machine to the north
that we passed earlier. Look at the chart below to see who to upgrade; there
are quite a few nice items in the next dungeon that are better than what we can
buy here:

.———————————————.—————————.—————————.
|   Character   | Upgrade | Upgrade |
|   Name        | Weapon? |  Armor? |
|———————————————|—————————|—————————|
|   Yuri        |    N    |    Y    |
|   Alice       |    N    |    Y    |
|   Zhuzhen     |    Y    |    N    |
|   Margarete   |    N    |    Y    |
|   Keith       |    Y    |    N    |
|   Halley      |    Y    |    N    |
'———————————————'—————————'—————————'

In other words, buy only Armor for Yuri, Alice, and Margarete, and buy only
weapons for Zhuzhen, Keith, and Halley, if needed.

  NOTE     Make sure to have 3 Will Powers and 3 Leonardo's Bears (optional)
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   for the next boss battle, as he can use both SP Lowering and
           Instant Death.

Feel free to stock up on healing items. When you're ready, leave Roger's house
and return to the Monastery Ruins at the top of the hill to have Roger unlock
the path to the underground ruins.

  NOTE     With the newer weapons, the hit area is decreased once again. We'll
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   be finding another Mind's Eye inside (which I think works great with
           Margarete, since she has one of the easiest rings), so you may want
           to invest the Cash with Meiyuan to increase both Yuri's and
           Margarete's Hit Areas to help, ONCE you find their new weapons in
           the next area. Don't worry, they're not too far in.

When you regain control, go underground and feel free to use the Save Point,
then go west for a scene. Talk to Roger to have him recover your HP and MP,
then head west into the ruins.

  NOTE     If you want to just grab Yuri's and Margarete's weapons really quick
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   to upgrade them, Yuri's is one screen to the right and up (slightly
           hidden), and Margarete's is two screens to the left (slightly
           hidden).

Take a few steps down, then search to the right to find a [_LOTTERY TICKET_].
Down the next set of steps is a fork; make your way west to the next area, then
west once again to another. There's a slightly hidden chest directly to your
west; open it for a [_MAUSER PROTOTYPE_] for Margarete. At the fork here, take
the southeastern path to the next area, following it to another area with a
dead-end. Close the chest here to open a different one nearby, then make your
way back to the entrance of the ruins.

Back at the entrance, take the eastern path to the next area, where you'll be
at another fork. Continue east down the stairs to a dead-end with two chests.
Open the northern one to drop the guard from the blue orb, then examine the orb
to light up a pillar in another room.

Head back to the last screen, then head north, opening the semi-hidden chest to
your west to find a [_SILVER WOLF FANG_] for Yuri. Continue north to find a
chest that's unguarded; it contains the [_MIND'S EYE_], which I recommend
equipping on Margarete, but you can put it on whomever you like, if you're
comfortable with their ring.

Make your way west back to the entrance, then go back west to the fork where
you found the Mauser Prototype, taking the western path this time to the next
area. At the fork here, examine the red orb to the north to change the color of
the pillar in the other room, as well as remove the guard from the chest. Open
it for a [_HOLYBOOK-MARTYRS_] for Alice, then take the southwestern path at the
fork down the stairs to the next area.

Ignore the path to the east that leads to the glowing red pit for now, and
continue southeast to the next area. Continue along past the now-purple flame
to the next area with a three-way fork near a yellow-guarded chest. Go
northwest up the stairs first, following the path through this area to reach
the green orb; examine it to change the pillar flame's color to white.

Make your way all the way back to the entrance of the ruins, then take the
eastern path to be at the fork near where you found both the Mind's Eye and the
Silver Wolf Fang. Head all the way north to open the chest that was guarded
before for a [_COAT OF THE SAGE_] for Zhuzhen. From here, go east to the area
where we found the blue orb, and examine it once again for the light go from
white to yellow.

If you're hurting, stop by and have Roger heal you and Save if needed, then
head back into the ruins and head west, returning to the fork with the yellow-
guarded chest. It will now be unguarded, so open it for a [_SEAL OF VITALITY_].

Now that you've opened all of the chests related to the puzzle, there's a VERY
IMPORTANT item that we must get. Go back two screens to the west to the glowing
red pit, where the [_DESTRUCTIONSTONE_] will float down into your possession.
You MUST obtain the DestructionStone to obtain either of the last two Fusions
for Yuri! If you don't, then you can't get them!!!

From the glowing red pit, make your way east two screens, then northeast and
east at the fork there to come to the end of the path. Use the Save Point, then
open the chests to the left and right of the large door here for a
[_SEAL OF STRENGTH_] and a [_PUNK JACKET_] for Halley. Save again if you like,
then examine the double doors. Ready?

———————————————————————————————
   [1] I'm not ready yet.
   [2] All right, let's go!!
———————————————————————————————

Choose 2 when you're completely prepared. Watch the events after you enter,
then climb all the stairs to find Albert, where you'll have to face him.

Watch the long series of events, then you'll regain control in Roger's house.
Complete the Spin Ring 3 to send Roger off, the watch another scene until you
regain control. Leave Roger's house and Nemeton Monastery.

There's one last thing to do story-wise before taking on a plethora of side
quests to get everything else in the game, as well as determine which ending
we'll receive. Head to Old Castle Street in London.

                           London, Old Castle Street
=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=

Make your way to the London Rats' hideout, and head to the top floor. Watch the
events up here with Koudelka and Halley, as well as with the rest of your
party. Watching this event will allow you to now complete the rest of what the
game has to offer, so make sure to watch this before trying to continue on with
the side quests!

  NOTE     Keep in mind that in addition to Meiyuan, Chris in the London Rats'
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   hideout can now switch your party members for you.

Now, we're SUPPOSED to continue with the story, but there's an unholy amount to
do, side-quest wise! If you don't care about side-quests or the good ending,
then just go to W-2-14 - Nemeton Monastery (2). Otherwise, let's get started
below!

AT THIS POINT, DO NOT TALK TO ROGER BACON AT NEMETON MONASTERY! It's best to
keep the story from progressing before we take care of the side quests.
